title: Cheerful Amnesia
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Arisa loses her memories of the past three years, including her whole relationship with her girlfriend Mari. Instead of ending things, Arisa falls in love with Mari all over again and sets out to relive their firsts. It is a short four-panel (4-koma) comedy about an adult couple, tagged as married in the databases.
life_message: Love that chooses the same person again, through any loss, is what makes a life together.

content.note: Memory loss after brain injury played for comedy (blurb).
